enabled.title: Enable the shared clip list
enabled.description: Keep enabled while Random Clip Player, Clip Courier, or another clip add-on needs it.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh the Twitch clip list every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: One refresh is shared by every clip consumer. The minimum is five minutes.

clipCount.title: Recent clips requested from Twitch
clipCount.description: How many public clip records the approved Streamer.bot action requests per refresh.

maximumCache.title: Maximum clip records kept locally
maximumCache.description: Only bounded metadata is kept; this is not a video download limit.
